summary: Backend-only requested scope completed for $1 access payment recovery. Ran existing focused regression suite plus new narrow recovery tests for fulfilled+verified order healing, idempotent restoration, negative guardrails, and backup roundtrip behavior.
action_items: No backend defects found in this scoped regression run.
Main agent can proceed with confidence for the $1 payment recovery path.
critical_code_review_comments: Recovery guard in has_paid_access is correctly constrained to kind='access', payment_verified=true, chain_id=4663 and status in delivering/fulfilled, preventing accidental grant from pending/failed/market records.
submit_access correctly short-circuits already-fulfilled same-hash orders to access_status without re-verification/re-broadcast in the tested path.
sync_db_to_file/sync_db_from_file now preserves access_entitlements, and legacy order-only backup self-heals entitlement via durable verified order.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed only scoped backend regressions per request. Verified recovered paid access from verified fulfilled order with missing entitlement, immediate paid response on repeat submit with same hash, timestamp preservation, negative non-grant scenarios, and backup roundtrip/self-heal behaviors.
rca of the issue: Root cause pattern validated by tests: entitlement could be missing while purchase_orders had durable verified fulfilled access payment. Recovery path now derives paid access from server-verified order and writes entitlement idempotently without requiring fresh quote/chain action.
